scope: Firmware RAM only;bounded connector source/destination and type1 I2C/type2 HPD records;unique GPIO I2C/PinLUT1.1 lookup. Other known records skipped by checked extent;no active port/encoder/AUX-channel resolution or device access. Separate direct displaypath/encoder correlation and raw16bit encodercap inventory;no active-link inference.

limits.capabilities: Private receive and send endpoints only
limits.boot_abi: v11,size1632,previous offsets preserved;loader and kernel packaged together
limits.lifetime: EfiLoaderData allocation retained for boot,including optional changed-source allocation. PMM only owns EfiConventionalMemory. Diagnostic mappings end with managed-service teardown;source never freed.
limits.transaction: At most4seconds CPU admission around private RPC loop;an in-flight RPC and teardown keep their own existing bounds;not a hardware timeout
limits.routing_failure: Directory preserved;failed route cleared to status only;no partial GPIO/link fields
limits.byte_windows: Kernel requests up to256bytes through <=32 private Ring3 reads,1..8bytes each;no privileged source dereference;existing RO/NX borrowed mapping and CPU stop ledger;four-second admission plus independent startup/RPC/stop bounds
limits.end_token: Inspect one checked type byte first;FF completes stream without reading size. Other records require full two-byte header and checked extent;64-record budget and per-route zero-on-refusal unchanged. Pinned consumer tests FF before ucRecordSize;actual captured board places FF immediately before next declared section.
limits.topology: Separate4word-per-connector tail after fixedV2route slots. Profile:unique version1 path,oneencoder;matchconnector source,encoder sourceGPU/destinationconnector,unique type20 capability. Othergraphs refused;rawcaps/IDs not activeport or deviceauthority.
limits.topology_failure: Directory/routes preserved;failed topology cleared to status only;unrelated valid peer retained.
limits.connector_partitions: Encoderdata cannot overlap header,directories,path extent or conservative connector link/record partitions,including padding.
